The fantasy every Bioexotics® customer asks about, and few can afford. Self-repairing scales, a throat full of fire and bones to carry it all. Biotechnica calls it the top of the line, and it knows who's buying: people who want the whole room to stop talking.

Package: FantaForm
Humanity Loss: 36
Includes: Combat Jaw, Combat Tail, Cyberarm ×2, Cybereye ×2, Cyberleg ×2, Dense Marrow, Firebreather, Grafted Muscle and Bone Lace ×2, Implanted Linear Frame Beta, Nano-Plating (scales), Wolvers ×2. BODY 4+ required.

Install the pieces it includes as cyberware; the package price covers them all.

Item Compendium (2070) • Cyberware
